svg.title: Live surveillance and intelligent alerts
svg.desc: A blue-lit three-dimensional surveillance monitor shows four security camera views: a parked car, a delivery truck, a glass entrance, and a perimeter fence. Animated scan lines and detection corners move within the camera views. Cyan data flows from three monitor ports to notification cards, whose bells ring and status lights pulse. Entirely editable vector artwork, with no embedded raster images or external resources. Motion respects the reduced-motion preference.
